settings.heading: Your apothecary to bicycles and bicycle components in the UAE!

settings.text:
Have you ever seen someone riding a bike while sad? At The Floating Pivot we make sure to put an even bigger smile on your face! 

Our venture in bicycles & components started in Dubai in 2017. Dedicated to bringing the best components and accessories to the mountain bike community as we felt a rush and a big need for upgrading and always staying ahead on performance.

Since then, we have acquired some of the most exciting and innovative brands in the industry and look forward to expanding with more partners to complete our product offering. Our ultimate mission is to help and support the middle east cycling community by making all those cool bicycles and components available at amazing prices.
